name: NOCTA x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Certified Lover Boy'
story_html: The NOCTA x Nike Air Force 1 Low ‘Certified Lover Boy’ delivers Drake’s subtle twist on the classic white-on-white AF1 colorway. The low-top dons a white tumbled leather upper, accented with a tonal Swoosh and mismatched NOCTA and Nike Air branding on each heel tab. Heritage details include a perforated toe box, variable width lacing and a low-cut padded collar. The vintage hoops shoe rests on a matching white midsole, featuring ‘Love You Forever’ inscribed in embossed lettering across the lateral sidewall.
